seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Mill Valley, CA: Winterfest with toddler trains and Santa at Depot Plaza, a gingerbread house party and a Tam Valley breakfast with Santa.
lede: Mill Valley gathers for Christmas at Depot Plaza, the old train depot square, where Winterfest brings toddler train rides, Santa and the community tree lighting to downtown.
celebrates: The Mill Valley Chamber of Commerce hosts Winterfest, the 94941's annual holiday celebration, at Depot Plaza in downtown Mill Valley. The free afternoon has dance performances, electric toddler train rides, a visit from Santa and the community tree lighting, and this year adds a holiday lighting installation at Depot Plaza and beyond. The chamber pairs the day with a gingerbread house decorating party, and neighborhood groups such as the Tam Valley Community Center host their own Breakfast with Santa for families who want a quieter morning with Santa, listed on this page.
lastyear: The chamber's Winterfest has been a December fixture for years. An earlier listing for the 2023 festival shows Winterfest and Tree Lighting on December 3 and 17, and a chamber Facebook post for this year says last year's Winterfest set the bar and that the chamber is raising it. The event has long centered on Depot Plaza, with Santa, performances and a tree lighting at the heart of the day.
facts: Depot Plaza has railroad roots. The Mill Valley Historical Society says the downtown depot originally served the North Pacific Coast Railroad beginning in 1890 and the Mt. Tam and Muir Woods Scenic Railway built in 1896. In August 1896 the Mill Valley and Mt. Tamalpais Scenic Railway began operating from the downtown depot to the top of Mt. Tamalpais. The Historical Society was founded in 1978 to discover, preserve and share the town's history.
trains: Mill Valley was a railroad town. Depot Plaza marks the spot where the North Pacific Coast Railroad arrived in 1890 and where the Mill Valley and Mt. Tamalpais Scenic Railway left for the top of the mountain starting in August 1896. Today, kids ride electric toddler trains at Winterfest. For a real train, SMART serves the Larkspur station, which connects to the Golden Gate Ferry Larkspur terminal for trips to San Francisco, where three train museums are listed below.

faq: What is Winterfest in Mill Valley?

Winterfest is the Mill Valley Chamber of Commerce's annual holiday celebration at Depot Plaza. The chamber lists dance performances, electric toddler train rides, a visit from Santa and the community tree lighting. Admission is free, and the event page has the date and times.
Why is Depot Plaza called Depot Plaza?

The plaza is the downtown depot square. The Mill Valley Historical Society says the downtown depot originally served the North Pacific Coast Railroad beginning in 1890 and the Mt. Tam and Muir Woods Scenic Railway built in 1896, so the plaza has carried train traffic for well over a century.
Is there a Santa breakfast in Mill Valley?

Yes. The Tam Valley Community Center hosts a Breakfast with Santa that is already listed on Rally Takes the Train in Mill Valley. Winterfest at Depot Plaza also includes a visit from Santa, so families can see Santa at the free downtown afternoon as well.
Can kids ride a train in Mill Valley at Christmas?

Winterfest offers electric toddler train rides at Depot Plaza, according to the Mill Valley Chamber of Commerce. For a larger train ride, SMART serves the Larkspur station, which connects to the Larkspur ferry for trips to San Francisco, so a train and boat day is possible.
